name: User Directory Pipeline
description: Filters active users, sorts by name, extracts contact info, groups by department, builds a summary object per group.
expression: . | .users | map(select(.active == true)) | sort_by(.name) | group_by(.department) | map({department: .[0].department, count: length, members: map({name: .name, email: .email}) | sort_by(.name)})

name: Grade Classifier with elif
description: Classifies students into letter grades using multi-branch elif, then builds a results array with name and grade.
expression: . | .students | map({name: .name, grade: if .score >= 90 then "A" elif .score >= 80 then "B" elif .score >= 70 then "C" elif .score >= 60 then "D" else "F" end}) | sort_by(.name)

name: Safe JSON Parse with Try-Catch
description: Takes an array of raw strings, tries to parse each as JSON, falls back to a wrapped error object on failure, then filters only successfully parsed items.
expression: . | .payloads | map(try fromjson catch {error: "parse_failed"}) | map(select(has("error") | not))

name: Variable Binding with Nested Object
description: Binds a label into a variable, multiplies two numeric fields per item, sums them, derives a secondary value, builds a nested summary object.
expression: . | .source as $src | .items | map(.weight * .count) | add as $base | $base * 0.1 as $extra | {summary: {source: $src, base: $base, extra: $extra, total: $base + $extra, item_count: . | length}}

name: Custom Function with Conditional Logic
description: Declares a clamp function using if-elif-else, applies it to normalize all scores in a dataset to 0-100 range.

name: Text Analytics Pipeline
description: Takes raw text, splits into words, normalizes to lowercase, removes short words, deduplicates, sorts, and joins back.
expression: . | .text | split(" ") | map(ascii_downcase) | map(select(length > 2)) | unique | sort | join(", ")

input.text: The Quick Brown Fox Jumps Over The Lazy Dog the fox

expected_output: brown, dog, fox, jumps, lazy, over, quick, the

name: Nested Conditional with Try-Catch and Operators
description: Processes a config value: tries numeric conversion, classifies as high/medium/low with nested conditional, falls back to alternative operator on error.
expression: . | .entries | map({key: .key, rating: try (if (.value | tonumber) >= 100 then "high" elif (.value | tonumber) >= 50 then "medium" else "low" end) catch "invalid"}) | sort_by(.key)

name: Multi-Function Declaration with Chained Usage
description: Declares two helper functions (one uses a conditional), then chains them in a pipeline transforming a list of records.

name: Event Log Aggregator
description: Processes event logs: filters by date range using comparison operators, groups by event type, counts and extracts unique users per group.
expression: . | .events | map(select(.timestamp >= 1000 and .timestamp <= 2000)) | group_by(.type) | map({type: .[0].type, count: length, users: map(.user) | unique | sort})

name: API Response Normalizer
description: Normalizes messy API data: safe field access with try-catch, string cleanup with gsub, conditional type coercion, builds clean output objects.
expression:
def cleanName(): gsub("[^a-zA-Z ]"; "") | ascii_downcase;

. | .records | map({id: .id, name: try (.name | cleanName) catch "unknown", value: if (.value | type) == "string" then try (.value | tonumber) catch 0 else .value end, valid: has("id") and has("name")}) | map(select(.valid == true)) | sort_by(.id)

name: Statistics Calculator
description: Computes multiple statistics on a numeric array: count, sum, mean, min, max, sorted values, all combined into one result object using variables.
expression: . | .values | sort as $sorted | length as $count | add as $sum | {count: $count, sum: $sum, mean: $sum / $count, min: $sorted | first(.[])}

name: Config Merger with Defaults
description: Merges user config with defaults using alternative operator, validates required fields with conditional, builds final config.
expression: . | {host: .config.host // "localhost", port: .config.port // 8080, debug: .config.debug // false, name: if has("config") and (.config | has("name")) then .config.name else "unnamed-service" end, env: if .config.port == 443 then "production" else "development" end}

name: Nested Data Flattener
description: Processes nested department/team/member structure: flattens, transforms, filters by regex, and builds a flat roster.
expression: . | .departments | map(.teams | map({dept: .dept, team: .team, members: .members | map(select(.email | test("@company\\.com$"))) | map(.name) | sort})) | map(map(select(.members | length > 0)))

name: Threshold Deficit Report
description: Compares each record's level to its target with a helper function, computes the deficit, flags depleted records, filters positives, sorts by level.
expression:
def deficit(target): if . >= target then 0 else target - . end;

. | .entries | map(.target as $t | {key: .name, level: .level, gap: (.level | deficit($t)), depleted: if .level == 0 then true else false end}) | map(select(.gap > 0)) | sort_by(.level)

name: Full Pipeline: Parse, Validate, Transform, Summarize
description: Complete data pipeline: parses JSON strings with try-catch, validates with conditional + has, normalizes names, computes totals with variables, builds final report.
expression:
def normalize(): ascii_downcase | gsub(" "; "_");

. | .raw_records | map(try fromjson catch {error: true}) | map(select(has("error") | not)) | map(select(has("name") and has("amount"))) | map({name: .name | normalize, amount: .amount}) | sort_by(.name) | map(.amount) | add as $total | {total: $total, count: length}

name: Nested Aggregation with Tier Classification
description: Threads a label variable, sums an adjusted product across nested groups, classifies the total with a helper function, builds a summary object.
expression:
def classify: if . >= 500 then "high" elif . >= 200 then "mid" else "low" end;

. | .source as $src | .groups | map(.parts | map((.adjust // 0) as $a | .weight * .count * (1 - $a)) | add) | add as $total | length as $count | {source: $src, group_count: $count, sum_total: $total, average: $total / $count, tier: $total | classify}

name: Nested Try-Catch with Type Guards
description: Processes heterogeneous data types: outer try-catch wraps an inner conditional with type checks, inner try-catch handles string-to-number conversion failures, filters null values.
expression: . | .records | map({id: .id, value: try (if (.raw | type) == "string" then try (.raw | tonumber) catch -1 elif (.raw | type) == "number" then .raw else null end) catch null}) | map(select(.value != null)) | sort_by(.id)

name: Chained Function Declarations with Variable Threading
description: Two function declarations (classify with 4-branch elif, scale with arithmetic pipe to floor), variable binding inside map, piped function calls as object values.

name: Group Aggregation with Sorted Labels
description: Groups records by a key, computes count and sum per group, collects and sorts labels into a joined string, filters small groups, sorts by key.
expression: . | .records | group_by(.group) | map({group: .[0].group, count: length, sum: map(.value) | add, tags: map(.tag) | sort | join(", ")}) | map(select(.count >= 2)) | sort_by(.group)

name: Triple AND with OR Conditional
description: Triple AND operator chain in select filter, OR combined with AND in conditional condition, four comparison operators (>=, <=, <, ==), multi-branch conditional classification.
expression: . | .sensors | map(select(.value >= 10 and .value <= 90 and .active == true)) | map({id: .id, value: .value, level: if .value >= 70 or (.value >= 50 and .priority == "high") then "critical" elif .value >= 30 and .value < 70 then "warning" else "normal" end}) | sort_by(.id)

name: Slug Generator with Alternative Defaults
description: Function declaration with multi-pipe body (ascii_downcase piped to gsub), alternative operator for fallback defaults, string splitting for word count, select filter.
expression:
def slugify: ascii_downcase | gsub("[^a-z0-9]"; "-");

. | .articles | map({slug: .title | slugify, author: .author // "anonymous", words: .body | split(" ") | length, published: .published // false}) | map(select(.words >= 3)) | sort_by(.slug)

articles.title: Tech Review
articles.author: Carol
articles.body: A great year for tech innovations and discoveries

name: Full Kitchen Sink Pipeline
description: Combines function declaration with parameter, try-catch for safe conversion, AND operator in select, variable binding in map, ascii_downcase, tonumber, group_by, nested object in map, sort_by at multiple levels.
expression:
def badge(threshold): if . >= threshold then "star" else "none" end;

. | .employees | map(select(has("name") and has("department"))) | map(.department as $dept | {name: .name | ascii_downcase, dept: $dept, score: try (.rating | tonumber) catch 0, badge: try (.rating | tonumber | badge(80)) catch "none"}) | group_by(.dept) | map({dept: .[0].dept, size: length, members: map({name: .name, badge: .badge}) | sort_by(.name)}) | sort_by(.dept)

name: Hierarchical Access Control with Deep Conditionals
description: 3-level nested if/elif/else conditionals, 3 as-variable bindings, pipe chain inside comparison operand ($cfg | .strict), AND operator joining two comparisons, complex role-based access matrix.
expression: . | .config as $cfg | .users | map(.age as $age | .role as $role | {name: .name, clearance: (if $role == "admin" then (if $age >= 30 then "top_secret" elif $age >= 25 then "secret" else "confidential" end) elif $role == "manager" then (if ($cfg | .strict) == true then "confidential" else "secret" end) else (if $age >= 21 and .active == true then "basic" elif $age >= 21 then "revoked" else "none" end) end)}) | sort_by(.name)

name: Multi-Stage Text Processor
description: Function declaration with gsub pipe body, ascii_downcase, ascii_upcase, alternative operator for missing fields, split+select+length for word counting, unique+sort+join for tag deduplication, map inside object construction.
expression:
def normalize: ascii_downcase | gsub("[^a-z0-9 ]"; "-");

. | .documents | map({title: .title | normalize, tags: .tags | map(ascii_downcase) | unique | sort | join(", "), words: .body | split(" ") | map(select(length > 0)) | length, source: (.source // "unknown") | ascii_upcase}) | map(select(.words >= 3)) | sort_by(.title)

documents.title: Hello World
documents.body: This is a sample document here

documents.title: Data Report 2024
documents.body: Quarterly data analysis for the full year period

name: Capacity Tracker with Modulo Arithmetic
description: 4 sequential as-variable bindings with cross-references, modulo operator in conditional, floor on division chains, per-item average computation, percentage calculation inline, status classification using variable comparisons.
expression: . | .capacity as $cap | .loads | length as $count | map(.size) | add as $used | ($cap - $used) as $free | {capacity: $cap, count: $count, used: $used, free: $free, pct: (($used * 100 / $cap) | floor), per_item: (($used / $count) | floor), status: (if $free < 0 then "over" elif $free < ($cap / 10) then "critical" elif $free < ($cap / 4) then "warning" else "healthy" end), even_split: (if ($used % $count) == 0 then true else false end)}

name: Try-Catch Fallback Pipeline with Alternative Operator
description: Try-catch with alternative (//) operator for fallback chains, fromjson for JSON parsing, tonumber with chained //, keys+length on parsed data, type check combined with has using AND operator with pipe chains in both operands, two sequential maps with select filter.
expression: . | .entries | map({id: .id, data: ((try (.json | fromjson) catch null) // (try (.backup | fromjson) catch null)), num: ((try (.val | tonumber) catch null) // (try (.alt | tonumber) catch null) // -1), keys: (try (.json | fromjson | keys | length) catch 0)}) | map(select(.data != null)) | map({id: .id, data: .data, num: .num, keys: .keys, kind: (if (.data | type) == "object" and (.data | has("name")) then "named" elif .keys > 0 then "rich" else "simple" end)}) | sort_by(.id)

name: Deduplicated Aggregation with Modulo Functions
description: Two function declarations (parity using modulo operator, class using elif chain), unique_by for deduplication, min_by and max_by for extremes, as-variable for intermediate computed array, pipe chains inside object values, sort_by on final output.

name: Commented Filter Pipeline
description: Simple pipeline with standalone comments between each filtering and sorting stage.
expression:
. | .users
# Filter active users only
| map(select(.active == true))
# Sort alphabetically
| sort_by(.name)
# Extract just the names
| map(.name)

name: Arithmetic Pipeline with Comments
description: Arithmetic pipeline with comments explaining each transformation stage.
expression:
. | .items
# Multiply the two factors for each item
| map(.value * .weight)
# Compute summary statistics
| {total: add, count: length}

name: Conditional Classification with Comments
description: Stores input fields in variables with comments, applies conditional grade classification.
expression:
# Extract student info
. | .name as $name
# Store the score for grading
| .score as $s
# Apply grade classification thresholds
| {name: $name, grade: (if $s >= 90 then "A" elif $s >= 80 then "B" elif $s >= 70 then "C" else "F" end)}

name: Multiline Comment Header
description: Multiline comment block (consecutive # lines) at the top, followed by a data processing pipeline.
expression:
# Data Processing Pipeline
# Transforms raw sensor readings
# into a clean summary report
. | .readings
| map(select(. > 0))
| sort
| {min: .[0], max: .[-1], count: length}

name: Try-Catch with Comments
description: Try-catch conversion pipeline with comments explaining each transformation stage.
expression:
. | .values
# Try to convert strings to numbers, default to 0
| map(try tonumber catch 0)
# Remove failed conversions (zeros)
| map(select(. > 0))
# Sort ascending
| sort

name: Function Declaration with Commented Main Flow
description: Function declaration followed by a commented main flow pipeline using the custom function.
expression:
def double: . * 2;

# Apply double to each value
. | .nums
# Double every number
| map(double)
# Sort the results
| sort

name: Mixed Inline and Standalone Comments
description: Mix of inline comments (after expression) and standalone comment lines in the same pipeline.
expression:
. | .data # raw input data
# Filter by minimum threshold
| map(select(.value >= 10))
| sort_by(.id) # sort by identifier
# Build clean output
| map({id: .id, val: .value})

name: Group-By Aggregation with Comments
description: Grouping pipeline with comments explaining the group-by, summarization, and sorting stages.
expression:
. | .records
# Group records by state
| group_by(.state)
# Build summary per group
| map({state: .[0].state, count: length, total: map(.value) | add})
# Sort by state name
| sort_by(.state)

name: Multiple Multiline Comment Blocks
description: Pipeline with two separate multiline comment blocks (consecutive # lines) at different positions.
expression:
# Stage 1: Extract data
# from the input object
. | .records
# Stage 2: Scale each value
# and rebuild the objects
| map({name: .name, value: (.value * 0.9)})
| map(select(.value < 50))
| sort_by(.name)

name: Tag Normalizer with Comments
description: Tag processing pipeline with inline comments on most stages and standalone comments between others.
expression:
. | .tags # raw tag list
| map(ascii_downcase) # normalize case
# Remove duplicates
| unique
# Sort alphabetically
| sort
# Join into comma-separated string
| join(", ")

name: Conditional with Piped Condition and Branch
description: Unparenthesised pipes inside an if condition and inside its then branch, bounded by the conditional's own if/end keywords.
expression: . | if .items | length > 0 then .items | map(.name) | sort else "empty" end

name: Nested Conditional Without Parentheses
description: Conditional nested directly in a then branch, matched by its own if/end keywords.
expression: . | if .a then if .b then "ab" else "a" end else "none" end

name: Comment Inside a Conditional Branch
description: Comment written inside a then branch, which stays in that branch across the round-trip.
expression:
if .c then
  .a # keep the branch note here
| length
else
  "fallback"
end

name: Nested Semicolon Arguments
description: Function call with its own ';' arguments nested inside another call's argument list.
expression: . | .words | map(gsub("[^a-z]"; ""))

name: Keyword-Named Object Keys
description: Object keys written as the jq keywords 'start' and 'end', with the pipeline continuing past the closing brace.
expression: . | .events | map({start: .s, end: .e}) | map(.end - .start) | add

name: Keyword-Named Key Inside a Conditional Branch
description: Conditional whose branches each build an object keyed by the jq keyword 'end', so the branch boundaries survive the keys.
expression: if .done then {end: .at, status: "closed"} else {end: null, status: "open"} end

name: Comment After an Object Field Key
description: Comment written between a field key and its colon, which the field's value chain keeps.
